normal.text: Video Game: What Remains of Edith Finch by Giant Sparrow Edith Finch returns to her childhood home to explore artifacts left by her family members, all of whom died young. We slip into flashbacks from each family member, trying to uncover the truth: is the Finch family cursed?

My god. Could the machinima scene have handled this? A tangent, but kinda making me feel nostalgic for how the early internet video game scene was. The audience was willing to create and watch art made with such limited tools. There's nothing quite like that now.
